news_headlines.summary: Investment funds affiliated with Silver Lake, who are directors and 10% owners of Dell Technologies Inc., sold 382,000 Class C Common Stock shares on April 15-16, 2026, at prices ranging from $176.50 to $193.75 per share, after converting Class B shares. Despite these sales, Silver Lake entities, including director Egon Durban, maintain significant direct and indirect holdings in Dell.
